archived.bin.inspection: Reopened the enrolled historical bytes and emitted the acquisition marker from their computed digest, which matches source.json.

fresh.bin.inspection: Inspected the locally supplied fresh HTTPS snapshot. Its size and computed digest match fresh-origin.json, which records HTTP 200 at 2026-11-24T04:02:18Z with the source URL as both requested and effective locator.

comparison: All observed changes were confined to page delivery and client-side state. The twelve differing regions occurred in two script nonce fields, three hidden form keys, six client-side identifier occurrences and one data_id field. No meaningful publisher text changed. The publication identity, edition, published status, descriptive modality, complete abstract, both mechanism exclusions and applicability to the two claims were identical.

material_coordinates.convention: Zero-based raw byte offsets, end exclusive. Each [start, end, SHA-256] applies identically to all three bodies.

method: Read the SCES standard, protocol, source registration, both revision-1 claims and their revision-1 support bindings. Directly reopened each retained body, hashed all bytes with SHA-256, compared bytes at corresponding offsets across all three bodies, inspected the context of every differing region, and checked exact equality of the cited slices.
study_limits: The three bodies represent one publisher record and share its authority. Fresh acquisition provenance was assessed from the supplied metadata and retained bytes without a network request in this review. The findings concern the two recorded publisher-description claims for the specified edition. Technical clauses, implementation behavior and other editions were outside the inspection.
